title: Indigenous food environment and dietary patterns of Munda community of Jharkhand, India

rights_and_access.data_availability: Datasets used and analysed are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.

scope.geography: Murhu and Torpa blocks, Khunti district, Jharkhand, India
scope.population_scope: Munda-community households sampled in the reported study; not automatically representative of all Munda communities
scope.study_design: cross-sectional household study with seasonal dietary assessment component
scope.topic: food environment, household dietary patterns, food-access diversity and nutrition transition

exact_locators.supported_evidence: The article reports a cross-sectional study in 201 Munda-community households in Jharkhand; household surveys measured socio-demographic and food-access profiles and FFQs assessed household dietary intake in monsoon and winter subsamples.
exact_locators.promotion_boundary: study-design evidence only; no household-level participant records ingested

exact_locators.supported_evidence: The reported field sites are two blocks of Khunti district, with data collection in August 2019 and January 2020 to capture seasonal dietary variation.

Murhu and Torpa were purposively selected; 201 eligible households completed the household survey, with FFQs administered to 160 households in monsoon and 100 in winter and 49 households covered in both seasons.
exact_locators.promotion_boundary: sample-accounting evidence only; no participant identities or raw records ingested

exact_locators.supported_evidence: The article states that community-based participatory principles were integrated in tool development and data collection, that Munda youth participated in free-listing enquiries, and that Indigenous community members served as enumerators/local-language contextualizers.
exact_locators.promotion_boundary: reported research-process evidence only; not community-wide endorsement or validation

exact_locators.locator: Declarations > Ethics approval and consent to participate
exact_locators.supported_evidence: The article reports ethics approvals from IIPH-Delhi/PHFI and AIIMS New Delhi, district administrative approvals, cluster-level consents from village leaders, participant confidentiality assurances, and informed-consent procedures including witnessed verbal consent for participants unable to read/write and written consent for literate participants.
exact_locators.promotion_boundary: evidence of authors' reported study ethics/consent procedures only; does not authorize MLHKP redistribution of participant-derived material

exact_locators.supported_evidence: The article states that study datasets are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
exact_locators.promotion_boundary: dataset-existence/access-condition metadata only; no dataset access or reuse permission inferred

evidence_decision.reason: The peer-reviewed article is openly licensed and has exact HTML section locators, but the underlying household data, free-list material and participant-derived traditional knowledge remain separately consent/rights/cultural-access gated.
